SessionStart._comment: cost-router routing-status banner. Prints a one-line status showing active model tiers and remaining Opus budget. Suppressible via COST_ROUTER_BANNER=off. Matcher EXCLUDES 'compact' — upstream anthropics/claude-code#15174: SessionStart hook output is silently dropped after compaction (v2.0.72+), so running on the compact event is pure waste (matches the root second-brain hooks' stance). Output kept well under the 10K hook ceiling.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: cost-router per-prompt classifier. Classifies the incoming prompt into THINK/DO/SCOUT and injects a one-line advisory nudge. No LLM call — pure keyword heuristic. Suppressible via COST_ROUTER_AUTOROUTE=off. UserPromptSubmit hooks have no matcher (matcher field is ignored per this repo's convention).
